Question: as salam alaikum, I am studying in sweden and while studying working part time in Mc donalds restaurant.Its a cleaning job where we have to clean all the utensils,these utensils contain meat,beef (sometimes pork also).so my question is whether it is permissible to wash those utensils wearing a gloves. Also whether this work is permissible or not and the money obtain through this work is halal or haram. Answer ID: 4291 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 599/559=L/1429) The job is allowable and the earning is also lawful. But, this job is not good, look for any other job and leave it when you find any other suitable job. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
